title: Report structural facts from an owned Ghidra program, or prove an annotation persists
description: Read a stored program from a project this campaign owns and emit a receipt with counts, function and reference tables, and a decompilation digest. Optionally write a plate comment, bookmark and label in one transaction and verify them from a separate process. Never publish decompiled source, never annotate a project that is also evidence.
candidate_note: Prepared for coordination with the concurrent Supervisor campaign. Not registered for dispatch; this campaign does not own Supervisor resources.

input.program: <project path without a leading slash, e.g. DESK.EXE>

limits.decompile_output: written only to an explicit private --text-output path
limits.annotation_scope: one address, one transaction, a project created for the purpose

cancellation.resulting_state: a transaction that did not commit is discarded by Ghidra; an interrupted annotation run leaves no partial comment, but the project must still be treated as unverified until a separate verify run passes

cache.invalidate_on: any key change; a report whose stored fingerprint differs from the project's is not comparable

acceptance: The receipt identifies the program by project path and reports its language id.
Decompiled source appears only as a digest and a line count unless a private text path was given.
An annotation run reports committed and saved, and a separate verify run reports the same comment, bookmark and label.
Function names, boundaries and decompiler signatures are labelled as tool output, not as program metadata.
No project that is also evidence is annotated.
exclusions: no emulator, guest or VMware resource
no publication of listings, decompiled source or proprietary bytes
no semantic conclusion from xref counts: a missing reference is not a missing caller
